name: Israel
leaders: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu (Likud); President Isaac Herzog
summary: The 25th Knesset dissolved in July 2026. Polls show former army chief Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar ahead of Likud, with neither Netanyahu's bloc nor the opposition bloc reaching a 61-seat majority. Benny Gantz's Blue and White withdrew from the race on 19 October.

parties.name: Yashar
parties.polling: 22–23 seats, first place (Channel 12, Channel 13 and Kan, 23 Oct)
policies: State commission of inquiry into the 7 October attacks
Military or national service for Haredi and Arab citizens
Protect judicial independence; term limits for the prime minister
Strengthen the IDF and expand regional peace agreements
Cut crime, especially in Arab communities

parties.name: Likud (with New Hope)
policies: Netanyahu seeks to remain prime minister
Hard line on security, Iran and Hamas
Supports parts of the judicial overhaul
Merged with Gideon Sa'ar's New Hope

parties.name: Together (Bennett–Lapid)
policies: Replace the Netanyahu government
Joint list of Bennett and Yair Lapid, led by Bennett
Universal conscription including Haredim
State commission of inquiry into 7 October

parties.name: The Democrats
policies: Unify the Zionist left
Replace the Netanyahu government
Oppose the judicial overhaul
Diplomatic path with the Palestinians

parties.name: Shas
policies: Military service exemptions for yeshiva students
Religious character of public life
Welfare and cost-of-living support for low-income families

parties.name: Yisrael Beiteinu

parties.name: Otzma Yehudit

parties.name: United Torah Judaism

Funding for religious education

policies: Settlement expansion and sovereignty in the West Bank

Judicial reform

parties.name: United Arab List (Ra'am)

parties.polling: Below the threshold in Channel 12 and Channel 13 polls, 4 seats in Kan (23 Oct), outside both blocs
policies: Joint list with Yaron Zelekha
Burden-sharing in military service
Platform details limited in English-language sources

parties.name: Blue and White
parties.polling: Withdrew from the race on 19 October 2026 after polling below the 3.25% threshold
policies: Broad Zionist unity government
Security-first approach
Equal share of the burden in military service

chamber.name: Knesset
chamber.asOf: at dissolution, July 2026; Likud includes New Hope

poll.note: Opposition bloc 56, Netanyahu bloc 50, Arab-led parties 14. Channel 13 had 54/50/16 and Kan 52/50. People of Israel, Reservists and Charedi Public below threshold in Channel 12.
